input.sql: select * from ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_PROVIDER_ACTIVITY where lower(PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB) like '%dent%' or lower(PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB) like '%chir%'
select FLX_ANN_MOI, count(*), min(SOI_ANN), min(SOI_MOI) from ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS group by 1 order by 1 limit 5

input.final_sql:
select f.FLX_ANN_MOI as month, sum(f.PRS_PAI_MNT) as total_charged
from ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS f
join ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_PROVIDER_ACTIVITY d on f.PSE_ACT_SNDS = d.PSE_ACT_SNDS
where d.PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB = 'CHIRURGIE DENTAIRE'
group by 1 order by 1

final_sql:
select f.FLX_ANN_MOI as month, sum(f.PRS_PAI_MNT) as total_charged
from ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS f
join ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_PROVIDER_ACTIVITY d on f.PSE_ACT_SNDS = d.PSE_ACT_SNDS
where d.PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB = 'CHIRURGIE DENTAIRE'
group by 1 order by 1
